visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young East Asian man with short brown hair, wearing a white textured sweater, stands in a high-end 'THE WHOO' cosmetics store. He smiles broadly at the camera, gesturing towards the shelves behind him which are filled with golden and white skincare bottles. The store features black shelving with integrated bright white lighting and a large digital screen displaying promotional videos of skincare ingredients like ginseng. (2) A female consultant in a black blazer joins the man. They stand before a lighted display case. The camera cuts to a macro shot of the 'Bichup Ultimate Recovery Youth Serum' bottle, which is pearl-white with a golden cap. The setting is bright and upscale with polished marble-like surfaces reflecting the overhead studio-style lights. (3) The video cuts to extreme close-ups of a hand pressing the serum pump. A clear, viscous liquid with slight golden threads is dispensed. The scene briefly shifts to an indoor room where the man applies the serum and then uses a makeup brush on his cheek. The lighting here is soft and natural. (4) Back in the store, the consultant holds a burgundy 'Jinyulhyang' multi-stick. The man takes it and applies it to his undereye and cheek area. The camera moves in for a close-up of his smooth skin. Yellow and white variety text overlays appear frequently at the top and bottom of the frame. (5) They focus on a golden cushion compact. The woman opens it to reveal a fine powder and uses a white puff to dab it onto her face near the eye. The man watches closely, giving a thumbs-up gesture. The background shows more luxury branding and product silhouettes. (6) Swatches of pink and red lip balms are shown on a forearm. Photos of actress Kim Ji-won holding the product appear as inserts. The man applies a light pink lip balm to his lips and cheek, looking into the camera. The background screen transitions between various 'THE WHOO' campaign images. (7) The man and woman stand together, each holding multiple products. They wave enthusiastically to the viewer as the camera pulls back slightly. The black and gold store branding is prominent in the background under bright, even lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker with a friendly, energetic tone and high-pitched vocal quality speaks Mandarin Traditional Chinese. He delivers his lines at a fast speech rate with high arousal. Background music is a mid-tempo pop track with a strong drum beat and synth textures. There is a slight rustling of the speaker's white sweater. (2) A female voice with a professional, calm, and friendly narrative tone enters the mix. The male and female voices overlap briefly as they greet each other. The BGM continues at a steady volume, featuring rhythmic electronic percussion and a major-mode melody. (3) A mechanical 'click' and 'squish' sound occurs as the serum pump is depressed. The male speaker's voice becomes more animated and descriptive, with increased pitch variability. The ambient noise is minimal, suggesting a quiet studio-like environment inside the store. A soft 'brushing' sound is heard during the makeup application. (4) A distinct 'pop' sound signifies the opening of the multi-stick cap. The two speakers engage in a lively dialogue with frequent back-and-forth exchanges. The music remains a constant energetic layer, with a consistent 120 BPM tempo. A light 'sliding' sound of the product on skin is audible. (5) A sharp 'snap' sound is heard as the compact case opens. This is followed by a series of rhythmic 'patt-patt' sounds from the makeup puff hitting the face. The female speaker's voice has a rising intonation as she explains the product benefits, maintaining a professional clarity. (6) The sound of a lipstick tube twisting 'click-twirl' triggers this phase. The male voice expresses loud, positive exclamations like 'Oh!' with high valence and arousal. The music swells slightly in the mix, featuring brighter synthesizer harmonics. A series of soft 'dabs' are heard as lip balm is applied. (7) The BGM begins a gradual fade-out. Both voices speak simultaneously in a cheerful farewell, characterized by high-pitched, rising intonation. The overall audio quality is clean and compressed for broadcast, with no significant ambient noise interference.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Item 1 Showcase -> Item 2 Showcase -> Item 3 Showcase -> Item 4 Showcase -> Summary/CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase for the 'THE WHOO' luxury skincare and makeup line. It uses a high-energy vlog format where a male influencer visits a retail counter and interacts with a consultant to explain the benefits and application of four specific products, aiming to drive brand awareness and sales.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of brand logos, product close-ups, specific product benefit descriptions, and a call-to-action to visit the store.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social media editing with high density of variety-show style text overlays and jump cuts to maintain engagement.
